projects.title: Build Your Own Electronic Hacker Badge
projects.description: Create a programmable electronic badge that combines a natural wood enclosure with accessible electronic components. Start with a small prototype, then share reproducible designs for members to customize.

projects.title: Hacker Club CTF Lab
projects.description: Build a controlled, isolated environment for practicing offensive and defensive security. Use intentionally vulnerable targets and original challenges with explicit authorization and clear boundaries.

projects.title: 3D Printing & Prototyping Workshops
projects.description: Help community members turn a sketch into a printable object through collaborative design, prototyping and practical workshops. Begin with simple useful objects such as badge cases and cable organizers.

projects.title: RFID & NFC Experimentation Lab
projects.description: Explore RFID and NFC through authorized experiments with club-owned tags, readers and test devices. Create educational demonstrations of identification, data formats and security properties.

projects.title: Self-Hosted AI Security Lab
projects.description: Experiment with locally hosted AI models, security evaluation and AI-assisted development in a shared learning lab. Use synthetic or openly licensed datasets and record limitations alongside results.

projects.title: Community Honeypot Project
projects.description: Build an isolated, safely monitored honeypot environment and publish educational observations without exposing sensitive data. Begin with an internal simulation before any organizer-approved external deployment.
